+            # replace all occurrences of pair in the chunks that hold both

actions.reason: RegexTokenizer.train now counts pairs once and then updates the counts incrementally. Each merge only visits chunks that contain both tokens of the pair (found through a per-token set of chunk indices), subtracts the old pair counts, adds the new ones and deletes pairs whose count drops to zero. Ties are broken exactly as before, by picking the tied pair whose first occurrence comes earliest, which is what max() over a freshly rebuilt dict returns. When there is a tie, the code scans chunks in order with set.isdisjoint until it finds that pair. Equivalence harness: identical outputs. train_ir ratio 0.539.
